headline: CHC @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 3.56 at PIT 4.38, with a projected total of 7.94. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PIT: CHC moved -1.51 runs while PIT moved +0.08, changing the projected margin by -1.59 runs. The projected total fell -1.42, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Braxton Ashcraft has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Spencer Horwitz, Alex Bregman, Brandon Lowe, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ian Happ, Michael Conforto because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
